game_title: Return Or Print – Northern Wall Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Snowy Hold – Northern Wall, the northern wall: the innkeeper must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Northern Wall: the northern wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Northern Wall, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round, a new flint stones challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the court_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 600 points of flint stones by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 600, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Or Print' (Week 6 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Northern Wall'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Northern Wall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 600 within 46 seconds.
